role: external oracles for wall_resolution on the dielectric block over glass: the 3D finite-element solve of the widened table's substrate model, and RETICOLO's unstretched Li solve at order 30, which also checks that substrate model on a patterned layer; the widened table's criteria and the RETICOLO comparison written before measuring are asserted against them

references.build: FEniCS (dolfin) 2019.1.0, gmsh 4.15.2, PETSc/petsc4py 3.26.1, MUMPS 5.8.2 (conda-forge), one thread, out of core

modified.description: used through its public Python API; the package itself was not changed

references.settings: Maxwell3DPeriodic on a quarter of the cell at the full height over the substrate (x mirrors perfect electric, y mirrors perfect magnetic walls), the excitation the analytic air/substrate (Fresnel) field; second-order edge (Nedelec) elements, 400 nm of air and of substrate and 900 nm of perfectly matched layer above and below. R and T by projecting the periodic part of the scattered field on each diffraction order over an air slab and a substrate slab. Relative residuals of the direct solves 2.8e-12. The stored phasors are in gyptis's time convention, the conjugate of Wavebit's; the consumer maps them as sign * conj(E), sign -1 for p. Before measuring, the block's volume in the mesh was checked against the analytic one (to 2e-15)
references.discretization: tetrahedral meshes graded toward the walls and edges, two levels (coarser/finer: 51111/105016 cells), the finer with 0.69 million complex unknowns and a smallest edge of about 1.5 nm; the product side is a Fourier truncation of the same cell

references.build: reticolo_allege_v10 tree of the Zenodo archive 'RETICOLO V10.zip' (md5 9c9c5e23397c6db5b39f0ed8d0993b03), run by GNU Octave 8.4.0

modified.description: called through res0/res1/res2 from a driver script; the tree itself was not changed

references.settings: res1/res2 on the crossed grating: the block as a rectangle [0, 0, 200, 200, n, 1] (not a staircase) in a 400 x 400 nm period, 150 nm thick, air above, n = 1.45 below, normal incidence from the air; both mirror planes (parm.sym, one polarization per run), p = TM; Li's rule with no stretch (granet = 0, the only setting of the public version), fixed nesting (li = 1) at orders 24 and 30 and the symmetric nesting (li = 0) at order 30. The same driver first reproduced the eight RETICOLO values stored in tests/references/test_reticolo_li_nesting.py to 4.2e-11
references.discretization: truncation order N = 24 and 30 in both directions (scalar to RETICOLO)

generator.command: python fem_sym.py blk_d_sub <level> with the mesh rule v2 at levels 0 and 1; python run_reticolo_sub.py 12,16,20,24,30 1 and 30 0 for RETICOLO; then python make_golden_e.py, which takes R and T of the newest records, the finer level's plane field reduced to its in-plane components in single precision, and RETICOLO's totals for p at orders 24 and 30 and the other nesting

cost.note: the two finite-element levels (449 and 603 s; the finer level's first run was killed for memory while another job ran beside it and was run again alone); RETICOLO took 1 to 71 s per order. The machine shared its CPU with other work, so the time is not a cost measurement

cells.shapes: blk_d_sub: a 200 x 200 nm block centred in the cell

incidence.polarization: p (E along x; the square block gives the same for s)
incidence.source: a plane wave from the top

values.R, T: total reflectance and transmittance on the finer mesh level (level 1)
values.R_coarse, T_coarse: the same on the coarser level (level 0)
values.E_<case>: in-plane (Ex, Ey) on each patterned layer's mid-plane, E[plane, j, i, component] at (x[i], y[j]); complex64; gyptis's convention, normalised so the incident wave has phase 0 at the stack's top and x = 0
values.depth_<case>: each plane's depth below the stack's top, top layer first
values.reticolo_R, reticolo_T: RETICOLO's total R and T for p at order 30, fixed nesting (li = 1)
values.reticolo_R_other_nesting, reticolo_T_oth: the same at order 30 with the symmetric nesting (li = 0)

inputs.mesh_rule: v2 of 2026-11-22: PML 40 nm and air 20 nm elements at every level, refinement at the true edges and on the shapes' walls, top and bottom faces; the two levels differ only in the wall and edge sizes

outcomes.reference_self_check: u_F, the relative R change between the two levels, is 3.7e-3 (above 1e-3, which the criteria call weak); the finer level is within 6.5e-4 in R and 6.0e-6 in T of RETICOLO's order-30 value (1e-3 written before measuring), 2.2e-3 in R from its other nesting; RETICOLO's R moves by 1.4e-3 from order 24 to 30 and by 2.9e-3 between its nestings
outcomes.failed_or_discarded: none; the same measurement found RETICOLO (to order 40) and fmmax (to 1600 terms) not settled to 1e-3 on the metal block and the metal circle over glass, so no second reference is stored for those
